pairs.why: A has crisper carved face and ribs with a soft satin finish, while B reads a bit smoother and more molded-plastic, like a statue.
A's ribbed form and clean glowing cutouts match the clean, saturated finish of the real cards a little better than B's softer, glossier, more toy-like pumpkin.
A has a well-built carved face and a natural pumpkin silhouette, while B is rounder and glossier, which looks more like a statue.
The two are nearly the same, but B's darker, more jagged carving looks slightly grittier, and A keeps the cleaner finish of the real cards.
B's wider, upturned brim shows its underside and reads as a real felt hat with volume, while A's brim is flatter and more like a disc.
A's curved brim with a visible underside and its well-built buckle give it dimension like the real cap and fins, while B's brim looks flatter and more stamped.
They are almost identical, and A's slightly cleaner, smoother surface fits the simple shading of the real cards a little better.
A has more wrinkle detail on the cone, which runs toward the too-textured direction, and B's smoother but still soft fabric matches the real cards' finish.
